description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the Customer class, which extends the base Controller class and implements methods for displaying and managing a customer dashboard within the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for loading the dashboard view, saving configuration settings, and gathering customer-related statistics.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for the customer dashboard in the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for rendering the dashboard view and processing configuration save requests.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language resources, sets page title, constructs breadcrumb navigation data, gathers dashboard configuration and customer statistics, and renders the customer dashboard view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to save dashboard settings. Validates user permission, updates settings via the setting model, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML content for the customer dashboard widget, including customer statistics and links to detailed views.
